title: kit.taxonomy.v1
description: A site's information architecture as rules, never as page lists: the sections and groups every page belongs to (the vertical tree: home, section hub, group hub, page) and the facets pages are browsed by (the horizontal axes: audience, industry, product, capability, regulation, lifecycle stage, content type). The kit's page registry (src/registry.js buildRegistry) applies these rules to the project's pages; the menu, hubs, facet pages, breadcrumbs, related links, sitemap, llms.txt and search index are generated from the result. Labels here name generated hubs and facet values only; a link to an existing page always shows that page's own label.

browse.description: Where generated hubs and facet pages live.

titleStrip.description: Regular expressions removed from page titles to get the page's label (the site name suffix).

fallback.description: Where a page that no group rule matches is listed (so no page is ever an orphan).

contentType.description: The single-valued facet every page has one value of (guide, reference, comparison, …): the first value whose rule matches best.

synonyms.description: Groups of words the search treats as one (the first is the canonical term).

match.description: A page matches when any listed field matches. Strength, strongest first: sources and exact paths (4), path globs (3), families, parents, rails, surfaces and kinds (2), words in the title, heading or summary (1). A page goes to the group whose rule matches it most strongly; ties go to the first in order. within restricts a rule to an area; a rule with only within matches at 0.5.

sources.description: Tags the project's page input carries (e.g. menu:<legacy group id>).

paths.description: Exact paths or globs (* within a segment, ** across).

words.description: Whole words or phrases (case-insensitive) in the title, heading or summary.

within.description: Paths or globs a page must be under for the rule to apply at all. A rule with only within is the catch-all of that area: it matches more weakly (0.5) than any other rule.

hub.description: An existing page that is this group's hub; without it the hub is generated under browse.

weight.description: Added to every page's weight in this group (ranking in hubs, the menu and search).

hub.description: An existing page that is this section's hub; without it the hub is generated under browse.

visual.description: The widget archetype a page with this value is shown with when it has no widget of its own (content types only).
